$comment: The machine record beside the pixels for cinatra#2852 (PR #2863).
Per cell: the requested path, the FINAL path, the HTTP status, whether the card root attached,
the PNG's pixel dimensions and sha256, every anchor the recorder looked for with the count it
saw, the card's own visible text, and any page error. A screenshot is never the only evidence.
Counting rules are stated in drivers/capture.mjs and are re-derivable from the DOM.
runtime: DEV runtime - pnpm dev (Next.js 16.2.10, Turbopack), CINATRA_RUNTIME_MODE=development, NODE_ENV != production; a dedicated lane database on the verify Postgres (5634) and the verify Redis (6579), loopback-only; no model credential on this host
base: loopback only; records carry the URL PATH, never a host
